trial_court: Additional Sessions Judge, Gangapur City, District Sawai Madhopur, Criminal Case No. 119/2007
case_name: Munna Lal And Ors vs State Of Rajasthan And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Munna Lal and others (husband, wife, sons)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Rajasthan and Vijay Kumar

facts_of_case: Petitioner's revision against the order dismissing negative final report submitted in FIR No. 269/2005 was dismissed. Petitioner claims he has not committed any offence and his marriage is annulled by mutual divorce petition.

legal_principles.principle: Prima facie evidence is enough to take cognizance.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel for the respondent has submitted that prima facie evidence is enough to take cognizance, there is no infirmity in the order impugned.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the court to observe constitution of the offence at prima facie stage.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel for the respondent has submitted that the trial court is obliged to observe constitution of the offence at prima facie stage and each and every aspect is not necessary to be dealt with at the time of resorting to cognizance.

outcome.final_order: The impugned order is quashed, and the FIR No. 269/2005 is quashed.
